chunks: Sa'd ibn 'Abdillah from Muhammad ibn 'Isa from Ibn Abi 'Umayr from Jamil ibn Darraj from Abu 'Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

«The Mutamatti' (one performing Hajj al-Tamattu') has his 'Umrah valid until the setting of the sun on the Day of 'Arafah, and his Hajj valid until the setting of the sun on the Day of Naḥr (10th of Dhul-Hijjah).»
And from him ('Abdullah ibn Ja'far) from Muhammad ibn Sarw who said:

I wrote to Abu al-Hasan al-Thani (peace be upon him): What do you say about a man who performs Tamattu' with 'Umrah until Hajj, who arrived on the morning of 'Arafah, and the people left Minah for 'Arafat? Is his 'Umrah still valid, or has it lapsed? At what time does his 'Umrah remain valid if he is performing Tamattu'? He did not arrive on the Day of Tarwiyah nor the Night of Tarwiyah. What should he do?

He (peace be upon him) replied: «When he enters Mecca, if God wills, he shall perform Tawaf, pray two Rak'ahs, perform Sa'i, shorten (his hair), and exit with his Hajj, and proceed to the Standing (at 'Arafah) and surge forth with the Imam.»

key_terms.الْعُمْرَةُ إِلَى الْحَجِّ: 'Umrah performed specifically for the sake of Hajj (Tamattu')
key_terms.الْمُتَمَتِّعُ: One performing Hajj al-Tamattu' (combining 'Umrah and Hajj with a break in between)
key_terms.يَسْعَى: He performs Sa'i (walking between Safa and Marwah)
key_terms.يَطُوفُ: He performs Tawaf (circumambulation of the Kaaba)
key_terms.يَوْمَ التَّرْوِيَةِ: The Day of Tarwiyah (8th of Dhul-Hijjah)
key_terms.يَوْمُ النَّحْرِ: The Day of Sacrifice (10th of Dhul-Hijjah)
key_terms.يُفِيضُ: He surges forth (referring to the departure from 'Arafah)

ai.seo_question: What are the rulings for a pilgrim performing Hajj al-Tamattu' who arrives late to Mecca?
ai.summary: This narration from Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* clarifies the temporal validity of the 'Umrah al-Tamattu' component, establishing that it remains effective until sunset on the Day of 'Arafah. It further provides a practical juristic ruling for late arrivals who miss the Night of Tarwiyah, instructing them to complete the 'Umrah rites immediately upon entering Mecca before joining the main Hajj rituals. This highlights the flexibility in Shia fiqh regarding the timing of Ihram and the completion of minor pilgrimage rites within the Hajj season.
